questions.stem: What is the role of a step-up transformer in the National Grid?

options.text: It reduces the voltage for safe use in homes
It stores electricity for peak demand
It increases the voltage at the power station for efficient long-distance transmission

questions.explanation: A step-up transformer at the power station increases the voltage from around 25 kV to 400 kV for transmission. This high voltage means a lower current is needed, reducing energy losses in the cables over long distances.
